title: Canonical coefficient inverse-image exchange mates
statement: For a commutative square of schemes $f' h_S=h_X f$ and a commutative condensed coefficient $R$, use the module-object categories of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category]. Define ordinary and derived inverse-image/direct-image exchange maps by taking the adjunction mates of the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphism for this square, using the existing ordinary and derived coefficient-module adjunctions. The named derived inverse image is precisely the existing total left derived functor, with the shift comparison induced by that adjunction. Thus the maps are $h_S^*f_*\to f'_*h_X^*$ and $Lh_S^*Rf_*\to Rf'_*Lh_X^*$. No flatness or properness is required to construct them, and their definition alone asserts no base-change isomorphism.
